IF EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Attribute_AttributeType' and object_name(parent_object_id) in ('Attribute_Retired')) BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Attribute_Retired] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_Attribute_AttributeType]; END
IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AttributeType_Retired') BEGIN DROP TABLE dbo.AttributeType_Retired END
changeSet.rollback:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AttributeType_Retired') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[AttributeType_Retired]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(50000,1) NOT NULL, [ParentID] [int] NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [AttributeTypeCategoryID] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [ShowNameInTree] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_AttributeType_ShowNameInTree] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [DisplayFormat] [nvarchar](250) CONSTRAINT [DF_AttributeType_DisplayFormat] DEFAULT ('') NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_AttributeType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_AttributeType_ParentAttributeType' and object_name(parent_object_id)='AttributeType_Retired') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AttributeType_Retired] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_AttributeType_ParentAttributeType] FOREIGN KEY([ParentID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[AttributeType_Retired] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AttributeType_Retired] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_AttributeType_ParentAttributeType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_AttributeTypeRelation_AttributeType' and object_name(parent_object_id)='AttributeTypeRelation_Retired') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AttributeTypeRelation_Retired] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_AttributeTypeRelation_AttributeType] FOREIGN KEY([AttributeTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[AttributeType_Retired] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[AttributeTypeRelation_Retired] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_AttributeTypeRelation_AttributeType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Attribute_AttributeType' and object_name(parent_object_id)='Attribute_Retired') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Attribute_Retired] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Attribute_AttributeType] FOREIGN KEY([AttributeTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[AttributeType_Retired] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Attribute_Retired] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Attribute_AttributeType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Attribute_ParentID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Attribute_ParentID] ON [dbo].[AttributeType_Retired] ( [ParentID] ASC ) END
